name: Federal civil cases filed, by county of the plaintiff's residence, case type and year (Federal Judicial Center)
description: How many federal civil lawsuits are filed in each U.S. county, and of what kind, over the last ten complete federal fiscal years, from the Federal Judicial Center's Integrated Database (IDB). A case is counted in the county where the first-listed plaintiff lives (the first-listed defendant's county when the United States sues; the tract's county in land condemnation cases), by 16 nature-of-suit groups plus multidistrict litigations (MDLs), and rolled up to Probative's practice areas. One record per county carries all ten years, the prior-year change and the year-by-year history. Cases that cannot be placed in a county are published as rows of their own, per state and nationally: plaintiffs who live in the U.S. outside the court's state (with the MDL share), plaintiffs who live abroad, cases under a retired county code, and cases with an unrecorded county; district records add the same parts for each of the 94 district courts. Every state equals the sum of its counties and these rows, and the national total ties to the U.S. Courts' Table C-2 within a fraction of a percent. Only counts are published: no party, docket number or judge.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Federal civil cases filed, by county of the plaintiff's residence, case type and year (Federal Judicial Center) (Version 2.0.1) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24024299

distribution.name: federal-filings-county.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: federal-filings-county.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: federal-filings-county-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in federal-filings-county-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to federal-filings-county.csv on id.

recordSet.name: federal-filings-county
recordSet.description: The records of Federal civil cases filed, by county of the plaintiff's residence, case type and year (Federal Judicial Center), one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id (never reused)

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter code of the state or territory of the federal court (the court's state, not the plaintiff's), or US

field.name: level
field.description: county (the first-listed plaintiff lives in that county), former-county (a retired county code with several successors, such as Connecticut's old counties), county-not-recorded (a county code in no county list or one the court file uses statewide), out-of-state (code 88888: the plaintiff lives in the U.S. outside the court's state), outside-us (code 99999), retired-codes (a reconciliation row, not added to totals), district (one federal district court), state (the sum of the rows above for the state's courts) or us

field.name: year
field.description: The latest complete federal fiscal year in the record (FY N runs October 1 of N-1 to September 30 of N, by filing date)

field.name: fiscalYears
field.description: The ten fiscal years covered

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: value
field.description: Federal civil cases filed over the ten fiscal years

field.name: unit
